blocks.text: A short note on where the Head of Operations search stands before the weekend, so that you have the shape of it in hand. Since we agreed the specification, we have been mapping the market for the role at {{fact:f:E-2018-001.client}}, working the sectors where an operator of this profile is actually found, and the long list is coming together well. Nicole Donovan has begun the first candidate profiles, each drawn by current role and record rather than by name, so that nothing about a prospect's interest in the seat travels before it should.

There is one thing I would ask of you before we go further, which is a short read from your side on two priorities in the specification, so that I am not sending the team against a brief that has quietly shifted since we last spoke. So that discretion holds on the search, I would also suggest that we route every candidate document to you, Jason Vasquez, as the single point of contact at Davis and Sons, and I will keep the thread orderly from our end.

I remain your day-to-day contact on this, James Grant, with Nicole Donovan on the research bench, and I will send you a proposed date for our first review of the field as soon as the long list is closed. Ten minutes by phone works if that is easier than writing the two priorities out.
